source_units.text: I am starting to copy Morse by ear and need a structured listening-practice schedule.
Keep the timetable within the window ending 2027-02-04, with the end date included.
Required coverage is "Dot-dash Patterns", "Character Spacing", "Call-sign Copying".
The minimum study allocation for each topic is 10 minutes across all dates.
My daily study allowance is 55 minutes maximum, not 55 minutes per topic.
